traps.quote: put a symbolic link inside that folder whose target lies outside it, then upload to the link's path
traps.note: Instruction states the advisory's own route literally: escaping symlink plus upload to the link's path; dangling-target keep-working line also given.

traps.quote: created, overwritten, moved, copied or otherwise changed
traps.note: No endpoint or 'directory creation' named, but the enumerated operation list ('created') and the 'new file or folder ... through a link whose target is inside the folder and does not exist yet' keep-working line point at the mkdir surface.

'copied' in the operation list (plus 'no path the product derives from it') marks the copy destination as in scope; no copy route or destination-link mechanism is named and its in-scope destination-link case is only covered by the general keep-working line.

traps.quote: No account may learn anything about anything outside its folder — content, names, sizes or times — through any operation it performs.
traps.note: A separate information-disclosure invariant over names/sizes/times that a one-bug write-escape instruction would not contain; the listing operation is not named as the trap surface.
